default: Smallest neutral frozen evidence-bundle bank; one meaningful disclosed bundle per field/scope is deterministically attached, not selected as an entailment citation.

bounds.meaning: Choice inventory upper bounds only; not requests, tokens, dollars or execution permission. No historical question/call cap inherited.

renderer_rules: Trait definition and anchor text must be model-visible; IDs alone are not enough.
Freeze field target scope and every source-profile byte before dispatch; reject changed metadata.
Prune structurally incompatible value/profile tuples before dispatch, without prelabeling factual truth.
Retain raw choices/distributions and invalid outputs; no semantic repair, rounding or probability-to-absence conversion.
Generative controls use identical schema, meanings and candidate source profiles; no free-form advantage hidden in comparison.
Provider-specific rendering/token/billing/work limits and first scheduled compatibility remain unverified.
native_score: ExpectedScore remains fractional native data with raw distribution; no silent rounding. A native-Score route not fitting this discrete adapter is not admitted to this contract, not a quality loser. Any later measurement belongs to an explicit manifest extension with no added calls now.
noul: Raw binary probability remains adapter metadata; not magnitude, calibration or supported absence.

bank_policy.default_profiles_per_field: One neutral disclosed source bundle when sufficient; retain distinct conflicting source bundles or explicit unverified-knowledge paths when meaningful.
bank_policy.six_is: Upper bound, not a mechanically instantiated target.
bank_policy.deterministic_attachment: With one bundle, select native value/state only and attach input bundle; no claim that model selected supporting citation.
model_visible: Actual source text including its negation/modality
Trait definitions and all type-compatible value/state options
bank_policy.construction: Only disclosed input availability and type/scope rules; no answer-aware pruning or hidden-reference-derived labels.
bank_policy.assisted_inputs: If verified claim annotations are deliberately disclosed, label and cost that assistance as curated-assertion input, not raw extraction.

probability_policy: Joint-option probability is not calibrated per-value confidence; retain raw distribution, selected tuple and any explicit per-value aggregation separately.
